description: A shell script for automated dependency testing of OpenWrt packages, including environment setup, package testing, and build management.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: deptest_make
methods.description: Runs make with specified target and logs output.

methods.name: clean_kernel_build_dir
methods.description: Cleans the kernel build directory, preserving the 'linux-*' directory.

methods.name: stamp_exists
methods.description: Checks if a stamp file exists or is a symbolic link.

methods.name: test_package
methods.description: Tests a specific package by building it and managing success/failure stamps.

methods.name: bootstrap_deptest_make
methods.description: Runs a make target for bootstrap dependencies with logging.

methods.name: bootstrap_native_make
methods.description: Runs a native make target for bootstrap environment with logging.
